parameters.instruction: Read the dry aqueous recovered mass on the same balance. The balance refuses a warm or wet assembly.
parameters.inputLabel: Read the dry aqueous recovered mass from the configured simulated balance (g)
parameters.evidenceProvenance: learner-entered reading from the configured simulated balance; no expected mass is embedded

interaction.accessibleLabel: Read the dry aqueous recovered mass.
interaction.successCue: The dry recovered mass is on record.
interaction.invalidCue: Dry and cool the fraction before weighing it.

prerequisites.label: The assembly is cooled.
The watch-glass tare is recorded.

stateChanges: The dry aqueous recovered mass is recorded.

invalidCases.when: current node expects a different action
invalidCases.message: That action is out of sequence for the approved investigation.
invalidCases.recovery: Return to the highlighted step and preserve the fraction or evidence already collected.

invalidCases.when: execution is attempted before instructor approval
invalidCases.message: The separation plan has not been approved.
invalidCases.recovery: Submit the property evidence, chemical rationale, quantities, endpoints, and disposal plan for instructor approval.

invalidCases.when: a layer or recovered fraction lacks identity and provenance
invalidCases.message: The fraction cannot be interpreted safely without a label.
invalidCases.recovery: Label the vessel with source stage, observed layer, retained material, and uncertainty before continuing.

invalidCases.when: a warm assembly is placed on the balance
invalidCases.message: A warm vessel damages the balance and convection makes the reading falsely low.
invalidCases.recovery: Move it aside with the tongs and let it reach room temperature before weighing.

invalidCases.when: a final mass is read before the fraction is dry
invalidCases.message: Residual solvent is weighed as product, so a wet mass overstates every recovery.
invalidCases.recovery: Dry the fraction to the approved endpoint, cool it, then read the balance.

invalidCases.when: a recovered fraction is named from an expected recipe rather than from evidence
invalidCases.message: A solid recovered by bicarbonate extraction and re-acidification is an acid; that does not make it aspirin.
invalidCases.recovery: Record what the recovery establishes and what it does not, and keep the component identity open until independent evidence supports it.
